source_note: This exact YFR068/A5 record replaces the former generic Airwolf current-gravel lead; sibling YFR003 evidence is not transferred. The exact storefront supports the specifications above. The secondary size-54 geometry is 555 mm stack, 388 mm reach, 72° head angle, 420 mm chainstays and 1,010 mm wheelbase, but it is not promoted as official until it can be matched to the current product.
